title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: DARIUS AND MOM
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Darius Webb, a highway line painter from Bismarck, North Dakota.
Since his dad Leon passed in the spring, his mom Lorraine hadn't left her house.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE DUSTY TABLE
segments.quote: No space of regret can make amends for one life's opportunity misused.
segments.author: Charles Dickens
lines: Every Sunday, Darius dropped off groceries and left in ten minutes.
Mom's puzzle table was buried under mail.
He remembered old Marley's warning in Charles Dickens's Christmas Carol:
No space of regret can make amends for one life's opportunity misused.
That night, he signed them both up for the library's speed puzzle contest.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: SLOW EYES
segments.quote: Nobody sees a flower really; it is so small; we haven't time, and to see takes time, like to have a friend takes time.
segments.author: Georgia O'Keeffe
lines: Their first try took three hours. Darius grabbed pieces like he was late for work.
Mom turned one slowly and read him a line from the painter Georgia O'Keeffe:
Nobody sees a flower really; it is so small; we haven't time, and to see takes time, like to have a friend takes time.
So he slowed down and looked. At the pieces. And at her.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: ONE JOB EACH
segments.quote: Individual commitment to a group effort, that is what makes a team work, a company work, a society work, a civilization work.
segments.author: Vince Lombardi
lines: Next Sunday, they reached for the same piece and bonked heads. Twice.
Dad's old Packers mug had a line from coach Vince Lombardi:
Individual commitment to a group effort, that is what makes a team work, a company work, a society work, a civilization work.
So Mom did the edges, Darius sorted by shape, and their time dropped to ninety minutes.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE BLUE SKY
segments.quote: Anything that's human is mentionable, and anything that is mentionable can be more manageable.
segments.author: Fred Rogers
lines: Then came a puzzle with a huge blue sky. It got very quiet.
Darius said, Dad would have hated this sky. Then he thought of Mister Rogers:
Anything that's human is mentionable, and anything that is mentionable can be more manageable.
So they talked about Dad. His awful jokes. They cried a little, laughed a lot, and finished the sky.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: CONTEST DAY
segments.quote: Concentration is a fine antidote to anxiety.
segments.author: Jack Nicklaus
lines: Contest day. Forty teams. The puzzle was five hundred pieces of dog fur.
Darius's hands shook. Mom whispered golfer Jack Nicklaus, Dad's hero:
Concentration is a fine antidote to anxiety.
One piece, then the next. Third place, behind two eighty-year-old twins.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE FULL TABLE
segments.quote: Those who are happiest are those who do the most for others.
segments.author: Booker T. Washington
lines: Driving home, Mom looked at the dark house next door. Mister Hal, alone since his wife passed.
Darius thought of Booker T. Washington:
Those who are happiest are those who do the most for others.
Now Thursday is puzzle night at Mom's. Six neighbors, and Mister Hal hides the edge pieces.
Darius brings pizza. He never leaves in ten minutes.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Show up. Slow down. Work as one. Say it out loud. Focus. Do for others.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Show up. Slow down. Work as a team. Say it out loud. Focus. And do for others.
I did a puzzle once. Took me a month. The box said two to four years, so I was very proud.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
